title: WinUI feature-parity matrix schema (documentation contract)
description: Declarative contract for the feature-parity matrix rows. The validator (validate_matrix.py) parses the Markdown table and enforces these rules: every row has a feature, source-of-truth, status (PASS/PENDING/BLOCKED), and automation evidence; PASS requires non-empty evidence; --require-pass rejects any non-PASS row.

columns.description: Canonical column headers in the Markdown table.

statuses.description: Allowed status values and their meaning.

PENDING.const: Not yet migrated or not yet verified.

BLOCKED.const: Migration blocked on a dependency; allowed in Phase 4, rejected by --require-pass.

require_pass_rule.const: Phase 5 cutover requires every row PASS; the CI gate runs validate_matrix.py --require-pass.
